name: CiteStamp
summaryZh: 核对引用对应的文献记录，查看 CiteStamp 引文图谱、反驳和复现记录，检索会向外部元数据与 CiteStamp 服务发送标识符或题名。
description: Citation health inside Zotero: does each reference resolve to a real work, does it have recorded refutations or failed replications, and where it sits in the CiteStamp graph. Zotero 8 and up.
